pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown regions exhibit irregular, polygonal geometries with low-contrast, fuzzy pixel gradients at the boundaries rather than sharp edges. Patch area is heterogeneous, with larger contiguous shapes on the neck transitioning to smaller, more fragmented regions on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space creates a continuous interconnected topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively consistent across the mid-flank but narrows significantly in the posterior region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the neck exhibits a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette. Individual hair clusters create a non-linear 1D geometric contour against the sky and background foliage.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A prominent region of textural disruption and dark hyper-pigmentation is visible on the upper dorsal ridge/shoulder area, characterized by a lack of defined patch-corridor structure and a thickened, crusty surface appearance.
